component.name: Nerimity
component.summary: Modern, sleek chat client for the Nerimity platform

description.p: This is an UNOFFICIAL, community-maintained Flatpak packaging of the Nerimity desktop client (github.com/Nerimity/nerimity-desktop), built and submitted independently of the Nerimity project maintainers. It is not officially endorsed by or affiliated with the Nerimity team.

Nerimity is a modern chat application. The desktop client wraps the Nerimity web app (nerimity.com) and adds native integrations: system tray, push-to-talk global hotkey, and Rich Presence via a local WebSocket bridge.

Some native OS-integration features (global hotkeys, other-app-window detection for Rich Presence, per-app audio loopback capture) may not function inside the Flatpak sandbox on all desktops; the app continues working for chat and calls even when those extras are unavailable.
